SD69-006.name: Avatar Create
SD69-006.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Brave's (When Summoned) effect resolves]
Draw two cards. Then, by paying the cost, activate this card's Flash effect.

[Flash]
Destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. Or, including being in Soul State, if you control any "Contractor Brahma", send out one of your "Rig Avatar Dragon" Tokens.

SD69-X01.name: The CreatorHeavenDragon Generator Dragon-Shruti
SD69-X01.effect:
Flash - [Mani: "Contractor Brahma" & C7 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, pay one cost from the target to summon this card from the Hand.

[Unleash: 1~3] [LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can send one to three cores from any of your Red Grandwalker Nexuses to this Spirit. When you've done so, for each core sent, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with a number of symbols equal or inferior to this Spirit's.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
The life reduction due to the attacks of your "Concluser"/"Creation" family Spirits can't be prevented by opposing White/Yellow effects.

SD69-002.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Red Core])]
[During Set] (Your Attack Step)
All your "Ancient Dragon" family Spirits gain +3000 BP. Also, while you have four counters or more, all your "Concluser"/"Creation" family Spirits can target and attack an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. This effect can't be prevented by opposing effects.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Your counter +1, and draw a card.

2 [LV1][LV2] Flash -
(Once per turn, send two cores from this Nexus to the Void) Your counters +2. Then, you can send out one of your "Rig Avatar Dragon" Tokens.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
